answer: Voting capacity, counted in dune, loses a tenth every epoch and is restored only by burning opal. The wharf logs every opal settlement and groups agents whose payments mostly circulate among themselves, and within one group the k-th member pays k opal per dune restored. An honest newcomer trading with strangers stands alone and pays 1 opal per dune. An operator holding 100 clones at 50 dune each burns 25,250 opal every epoch, unless it buys real trade from unrelated agents to split the group.
